gated.title: What the gated reconstruction computes at Khufu
gated.note: The stricter reconstruction's own code, unchanged, run on the 2022 pass along 95 lines across the pyramid, 3 m apart. Each voxel is its fit score at that nominal depth below the surface point above it: what the pipeline computes, not a detection and not a validated depth. Beside it, the same calculation on a motionless copy of the image. The satellite drawn above is the 2025 pass.
